• No client secret in the app, because underneath it is still authorization code with PKCE.
  • A real Drupal session, which your editors need if they work in Drupal's admin pages through the frontend. logout() ends it.
  • Drupal and the frontend have to look like one site to the browser, so it needs the proxy.
